name: io.github.happy520ai/gateway-price-check
title: Gateway Price Disclosure Check
description: Answers one question about any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: can you see its model prices without an account or key? Sends a single unauthenticated GET /v1/models and returns one of five verdicts (YES / NO / AUTH / ERR / UNKNOWN) that keep "publishes no prices" separate from "the probe could not read it". https-only, refuses loopback and private hosts, never sends a key or a completion request, and never asserts model fidelity.
